text: On the third morning, Hesta finds Kai a place with the academy's supply wagons. She checks his name with the driver. One of her riders stays beside him; the other brings her horse.

speaker: Hesta
text: He travels with you. If he is unwell, stop at the next post and send word.

speaker: Kai
text: You're not coming?

speaker: Hesta
text: I must reach Vael today. Stay with the wagons. Your escort will see you through the gates.
She waits for the rider to repeat the instructions. Then she mounts. By the time the wagons start moving, she is already out of sight.
A day from Vael, the wagons slow at a village. A cart lies across the road. Smoke climbs above the roofs.
By the well, a woman tries to pull a small boy behind the stone rim. Her leg gives way. A man with an axe steps toward them.

speaker: Kai
text: Leave them alone!
Kai is across the road before his escort can catch his arm. The boy stares up at him. Green light flickers at Kai's brow — and is gone.

speaker: Kai
text: Head down. Stay behind me.

speaker: Perrin
text: A stranger with an axe to his head. Right. That's my sort of terrible idea.
Perrin's blade bars the axeman's path. He presses forward, already a step too far.

speaker: Serra
text: You can't hold the road alone. Back a pace. Give me room. Keep the boy low — I'll help his mother.
Kai's escort gets an arm under the woman. Serra turns her lance across the road, buying them space to get the two villagers to shelter.

speaker: Rina
text: The one at the camp. They keep looking back at him. Drive him off and this may end quickly.

speaker: Rina
text: Your forehead just lit up. Did you mean to do that?

speaker: Kai
text: No.

speaker: Serra
text: Then use the sword. We'll cover you.

speaker: Perrin
text: And me. Perrin. In case we're doing introductions before the bad decisions.

speaker: Kai
text: Kai. Less talking, Perrin.
